---
name: First run
about: You ran it on your own data. Say what happened.
title: "First run: <tool>, <what it could see>"
labels: first-run
---

**Tool:** ChatGPT / Gemini / Claude / Claude Code / other

**What it could see:** nothing / memory / a project / a vault with history

**Rows it wrote:** how many, and one row pasted here with its quote

**Did the number feel right?** Yes, no, and the quote that made you say so

**On the next task:** did the reply carry the walkthrough, a call-out, a hand-back? Did it nag? Did it slow the work?

**If it refused or broke:** the exact message
